notes: The 150-prompt tool-selection set (docs/ASSISTANT_PHASE4_PLAN.md 3.20). Each prompt runs at its role with every flag on unless flags turns one off, with the real system prompt and the core tool definitions; a first round that calls find_tools or load_skill gets one more round with the surfaced definitions. Nothing executes. A positive prompt hits when it calls an expected or alternate tool and no not_tools name; a negative prompt (expected_tools empty) hits when it calls nothing outside find_tools, load_skill and its alternates. find_query, when set, is the query the offline resolver check uses instead of the message. Project ids are placeholders that never resolve: selection runs read nothing. Phase 5 adds seven capability prompts and seven review/destination refusals; explicit mode is server context. Browser v2 (docs/ASSISTANT_BROWSER_V2_PLAN.md 18.2) adds four prompts: an email link, a public question that needs web search and never the browser, a login site, and a sign-in code that is never read from mail. Phase 8 (docs/ASSISTANT_PHASE8_PLAN.md 6.3) adds five inbox prompts: what is new, what was flagged on a bid, a digest, a request to mark rows read, which the read-only tool cannot do (a look with inbox_list first is an allowed alternate), and an email-style search that merely says inbox, which must stay on email_search.
